# Locks the OAuth2 refresh-token auth shape contract end-to-end. No OpenAPI
# securityScheme maps to oauth2_refresh, so the internal fixture beside this
# case is the only golden coverage the fork has.
#
#   spec.go        → AuthConfig.Type=oauth2_refresh, TokenURL required
#   client.go.tmpl → refreshAccessToken: client pair via SetBasicAuth,
#                    rotated refresh_token persisted through SaveTokens,
#                    pre-request freshness branch on a missing/expired token
#   config.go.tmpl → AuthSource="oauth2_refresh", Bearer AccessToken emission

# client.go carries the token exchange. The load-bearing contract is that the
# client pair travels in the Authorization header (RFC 6749 §2.3.1
# client_secret_basic) and never in the request body — a provider that
# implements only the required mechanism rejects a body-only exchange — and
# that the rotated refresh token is written back rather than discarded.
golden-api-oauth2-refresh/internal/client/client.go

# config.go's AuthHeader must emit the AccessToken-first Bearer branch and
# tag AuthSource, which is what doctor reports and what SaveTokens updates.
golden-api-oauth2-refresh/internal/config/config.go
